verdict.rationale: Docs show LocalAI shipping as a prebuilt Docker image (`docker run localai/localai:latest`) and describe it as "One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API," plus a `local-ai run` CLI implying a ready-made binary rather than a source build. However, there's no mention of OS package managers (apt/brew/rpm) or signed release downloads. missing for 10: explicit package-manager installs (brew/apt/winget), signed release binaries/checksums, independent confirmation of no-compile install experience.
